pattern.short_summary: A free-form conversational channel is live at the same time as a non-conversational artifact the user is attending to, and the turns are about that artifact.
pattern.definition: A free-form conversational channel is live at the same time as a non-conversational artifact the user is attending to, and the turns are about that artifact. The artifact persists on display; the dialogue neither replaces it nor is required to advance it.
pattern.structural_signature: Two concurrently live regions (possibly on two devices): one holds a persistent artifact that is not consumed by the exchange, the other accepts an unbounded number of user-authored natural-language turns scoped to that artifact. Removing the dialogue channel leaves the artifact usable; removing the artifact leaves the dialogue without a referent.

dimension.category_description: How AI assistance is spatially composed with artifacts, panels, host tools, chat surfaces, presentation modes, and shared workspaces.
dimension.classification_boundary: Use for visible surface placement and integration, not sensory modality or physical-space registration.
